chip.description: 16-channel 8-bit PCM sample player, believed to be the integrated version of the discrete TTL PCM board used by Space Harrier (taxonomy §4.14 example, "Sega PCM").
chip.notes: src/devices/sound/segapcm.cpp in MAME 0.288 ("SEGA 16ch 8bit PCM"). Part number and board usage from the custom-parts table in src/mame/sega/segaic16.cpp ("315-5218 -- PCM sound controller", fitted to Space Harrier, After Burner, Galaxy Force and System C hardware; note (b) records the TTL predecessor).
